runtime_prompt_en:
A close full-body documentary photograph of field work at a closed rural level crossing in blue dusk. One clearly adult woman in her thirties is momentarily still during a cable test beside an open grey signal cabinet. Use the attached image for her visible face and hair appearance: a short dark jaw-length bob, wispy separated fringe, the visible eye shape, nose and mouth contours. She wears charcoal utility coveralls with the sleeves folded below her elbows and lightly scuffed flat work boots. Her right hand holds a pencil just above a clipped log card on a low service tray; her left fingertips steady the connected handheld meter beside it. A test cable visibly runs from the meter into the cabinet. She has looked up toward the lens with relaxed upper eyelids and softly parted lips. Her body remains in a stable half-kneeling stance. Her left knee presses directly onto a dark knee pad on the concrete; her right boot has its whole sole planted flat forward, with the right shin rising almost vertically. Her left lower leg extends backward, its boot forefoot touching the concrete with its heel lifted. Her hips remain between the planted left knee and forward right foot, and her torso inclines slightly forward. The front-right camera viewpoint leaves a clear view of her rear boot and all three ground contacts. Her nose points slightly toward image right. A small neutral-white work lamp just above eye height at camera left produces broad loop lighting: the wider camera-facing cheek on image left is bright, the narrower cheek on image right is darker, and a small oval nose-shadow sits on that darker cheek separated from the cheek shadow by a visible lit gap. Each visible eye holds a small crisp lamp catchlight on its cornea, with iris texture and lid edges resolved. Head, hands, both knees and both boots fit inside the close vertical frame, with the face and contact planes sharply resolved. A striped crossing barrier and faint amber signal behind her establish the closed lane; wet concrete picks up a dim amber streak while her face keeps neutral skin colour.
